scope: Default input scenarios, not the user personal workspace. Cash and other inputs may differ from the screenshot.

units.sleepDebt: unmet sleep hours in a model ledger, not physiological measurement

comparison: Each version compares its own unchanged arrangement against its adjusted arrangement.
sampling: Week-end fatigue at weeks 1..52; week 0 excluded from the average and burden.
assumptions: Sleep need is constant within a run
Only surplus sleep repays debt; meeting current need stops new debt
Sleep quality is held fixed, unlike legacy 1.0
Weekly aggregation cannot resolve daily timing
Parameters and nonlinear forms are not empirically fitted
